title: 通风柜的正确使用

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台通风柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a chemical fume hood with its sash half lowered and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲通风柜的正确使用。

shots.scene: 通风柜、视窗、风量表、警示铃四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a fume hood, a lowered sash with a down arrow, an airflow gauge and an alarm bell. No people.
shots.narration: 会看、会用、会应急。

shots.scene: 阿杰把视窗推到最高，探身在柜口倒溶剂，柜内堆满瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises the fume hood sash all the way up and leans in at the edge to pour a liquid; the hood is cluttered with many bottles.
shots.narration: 阿杰把视窗推到顶，探着身子在柜口倒液。

shots.scene: 淡淡的蒸气从柜口飘向阿杰的脸
shots.prompt_en: Faint vapor curls out of the front of the hood toward the young male student's face.
shots.narration: 蒸气顺着柜口飘了出来。

shots.scene: 小研拍拍他的肩，指着风量表和视窗标线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student taps his shoulder and points at the airflow gauge and the sash height mark.
shots.narration: 小研提醒：通风柜也得会用才管用。

shots.scene: 欣欣在通风柜前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a fume hood and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 用不对，它就护不住你。

shots.scene: 烧杯上方冒出烟、雾、蒸气、粉尘四种图标
shots.prompt_en: Above a beaker, four small icons rise: smoke, mist, vapor and fine dust particles. No people.
shots.narration: 很多物质会放出有害的烟、雾、蒸气和颗粒。

shots.scene: 这些图标被收进通风柜里
shots.prompt_en: The smoke, mist and particle icons are drawn into a fume hood by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 要少吸进去，就把操作放进通风柜。

shots.section_title: 化学通风柜护住呼吸带
shots.scene: 化学通风柜正面，操作者呼吸带处标出绿色区域
shots.prompt_en: A front view of a chemical fume hood with a green highlighted breathing zone in front of it where a user would stand. No people.
shots.narration: 化学通风柜最常用。
overlay: 化学通风柜护住呼吸带

shots.section_title: 化学通风柜护住呼吸带
shots.scene: 污染物被挡在柜内，不进入呼吸带
shots.prompt_en: Contaminant icons stay inside the hood and are blocked from the green breathing zone. No people.
shots.narration: 它把污染物挡在你的呼吸带之外。

shots.scene: 侧面剖视：空气从柜口流入，向上进入风管
shots.prompt_en: A side cutaway diagram of a fume hood: arrows show room air flowing in through the opening and up into the exhaust duct. No people.
shots.narration: 空气不断被吸进柜内，形成一道屏障。

shots.scene: 风管通向楼顶的排风口
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the exhaust duct running up through the building to rooftop exhaust stacks. No people.
shots.narration: 污染物随气流经管道排出楼外。

shots.scene: 楼顶排风口上方的空气逐渐变淡
shots.prompt_en: Exhaust rising from rooftop stacks and fading into the open sky. No people.
shots.narration: 在室外大气中被进一步稀释。

shots.scene: 飞溅的液滴和小火花被视窗玻璃挡住
shots.prompt_en: Splash droplets and a small flash hit the inside of a lowered hood sash and are blocked. No people.
shots.narration: 视窗还能挡住飞溅、喷射，甚至火和小爆炸。

shots.scene: 小研把视窗拉低到舒适操作的高度
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the sash to a comfortable working height, her arms reaching under it.
shots.narration: 能拉低就拉低，又要方便操作。

shots.scene: 视窗侧面的推荐高度标线
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a recommended sash height marker with an arrow on the side of the hood. No people.
shots.narration: 按标出的推荐高度来。

shots.section_title: 柜内操作也要穿戴防护
shots.scene: 小研穿实验服、戴护目镜和手套在柜内操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves works inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里，防护一样不能少。
overlay: 柜内操作也要穿戴防护

shots.section_title: 柜内操作也要穿戴防护
shots.scene: 阿杰翻阅一本空白的安全数据单
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a blank safety data sheet binder beside the hood.
shots.narration: 先读安全数据单，了解成分和危害。

shots.section_title: 柜内操作也要穿戴防护
shots.scene: 面屏和加厚手套图标加入防护组合
shots.prompt_en: A face shield icon and a thick chemical glove icon are added to a set of protective gear icons. No people.
shots.narration: 需要更多防护，就加上。

shots.scene: 日历上标出安装、改造和定期三个时间点
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with three marked points: an installation wrench, a duct change icon and a repeating arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 新装、通风改造后、平时定期，都要检测。

shots.scene: 老周和老李提着仪器箱走向通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The older man, a supervisor, and the facility engineer carry a measuring instrument case toward a fume hood.
shots.narration: 由主管或合格的工程师来检测。

shots.scene: 柜前空气侧向流动的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A top-down diagram of a hood with sideways air arrows crossing in front of its opening from a door and a supply vent. No people.
shots.narration: 先看柜子前面的横向气流。

shots.scene: 柜口前方六英寸处的测点，横向箭头带出蒸气
shots.prompt_en: A top-down diagram of a hood with a measuring point marked a short distance in front of the opening, and strong sideways arrows pulling a wisp of vapor out. No people.
shots.narration: 在柜前六英寸处测横向气流。

shots.scene: 老李手持探头在柜前读数
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds an airflow probe in front of the fume hood and reads a blank display.
shots.narration: 超过每分钟20英尺，就影响性能。

shots.scene: 发烟管在柜内放出白烟，白烟流向柜后排风口
shots.prompt_en: A smoke tube releases white smoke inside the hood, and the smoke flows smoothly toward the rear exhaust slots. No people.
shots.narration: 再用发烟管看看烟往哪走。

shots.scene: 烟顺利进入排风口，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Smoke entering the exhaust slots with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 烟流向排风口，说明气流正常。

shots.section_title: 检测三：用仪器测面风速
shots.scene: 视窗调到平时操作的位置，老李用风速仪测量
shots.prompt_en: The sash is set to the normal working position, and the facility engineer measures airflow at the opening with an anemometer.
shots.narration: 视窗放到工作位置，测柜口的风速。
overlay: 检测三：用仪器测面风速

shots.section_title: 检测三：用仪器测面风速
shots.scene: 一条薄纸条在柜口飘动，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A thin paper strip fluttering at the hood opening, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能用纸条来判断风速。

shots.section_title: 检测三：用仪器测面风速
shots.scene: 纸条图标旁的开关图标
shots.prompt_en: A paper strip icon next to an on and off switch icon. No people.
shots.narration: 纸条只能看出风机开没开。

shots.section_title: 逐格测量，不合格先调整
shots.scene: 柜口被划成网格，逐格出现测量点
shots.prompt_en: The hood opening is divided into a grid, and a measurement dot appears in each square one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 柜口分成小格，一格一格测。
overlay: 逐格测量，不合格先调整

shots.section_title: 逐格测量，不合格先调整
shots.scene: 网格中各点读数有高有低，仍在允许范围
shots.prompt_en: A grid over the hood opening with measurement dots of slightly different sizes, all inside a green band. No people.
shots.narration: 各点可上下浮动百分之二十五。

shots.section_title: 逐格测量，不合格先调整
shots.scene: 一个格子变红，挂上空白的停用牌
shots.prompt_en: One grid square turns red, and a blank do-not-use tag hangs on the hood. No people.
shots.narration: 任何一点都不能低于每分钟60英尺。

shots.section_title: 逐格测量，不合格先调整
shots.scene: 横流箭头与面风速箭头并排比较
shots.prompt_en: A short sideways arrow compared with a long inward arrow at a hood opening, with a ratio symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 横流不能超过面风速的五分之一。

shots.section_title: 逐格测量，不合格先调整
shots.scene: 老李调整柜内后部的导流板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer adjusts the baffle at the back of the hood.
shots.narration: 不达标就调导流板，或改实验室通风。

shots.scene: 气流过强时柜口出现漩涡，蒸气被卷出
shots.prompt_en: Very strong airflow arrows create swirling eddies at the hood opening, pulling vapor out into the room. No people.
shots.narration: 风速不是越大越好，太大会起湍流。

shots.scene: 风速表指针落在中间绿色区域
shots.prompt_en: A gauge with a needle resting inside a green middle band, red zones at both ends. No people.
shots.narration: 一般面风速每分钟80到100英尺。

shots.scene: 风速表指针稍高，旁边一个特殊操作图标
shots.prompt_en: A gauge with the needle a bit higher, next to a special procedure icon, and a red zone at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 有些操作约125，最高不超过150。

shots.scene: 通风柜上的空白检测标签和每年一次的日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection tag on the hood next to a calendar icon marked once a year. No people.
shots.narration: 面风速至少每年测一次。

shots.scene: 柜内烟雾打转、逸出柜口
shots.prompt_en: Smoke swirling inside the hood and drifting out of the opening, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 看烟有没有打转、跑出来。

shots.scene: 调整项图标：设备位置、风速、送风口、柜位、风量
shots.prompt_en: Five icons: equipment placement, an airflow gauge, a supply vent, a hood position marker and an air volume icon. No people.
shots.narration: 工程师会调整这些因素。

shots.scene: 阿杰在柜前闻到气味，打电话给老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices a smell near the hood and calls the older man, his supervisor, on the phone.
shots.narration: 觉得通风柜不对劲，告诉主管。

shots.scene: 老周在空白的评估单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank re-evaluation request form.
shots.narration: 判断是否需要重新评估。

shots.scene: 合格的通风柜和正在操作的人两个图标，各占一半
shots.prompt_en: A pie chart split in half: one half a fume hood with a green check, the other half a person working correctly. No people.
shots.narration: 装得好只是一半，用得对才算完整。

shots.section_title: 至少在柜内六英寸处操作
shots.scene: 侧视图：卷尺从柜口量到柜内的烧杯
shots.prompt_en: A side-view diagram showing a tape measure from the front edge of the hood to a beaker placed well inside. No people.
shots.narration: 操作至少在柜口以内六英寸。
overlay: 至少在柜内六英寸处操作

shots.section_title: 至少在柜内六英寸处操作
shots.scene: 放在柜口边缘的瓶子被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A bottle placed right at the front edge of the hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 贴着柜口，蒸气容易跑出来。

shots.scene: 摇床放在升降台上，下方有气流箭头穿过
shots.prompt_en: A shaker set on a raised stand inside the hood, with airflow arrows passing underneath it. No people.
shots.narration: 大设备挡气流，要垫高让风从下面过。

shots.scene: 柜内堆满瓶子的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood packed with many bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜不是储存柜。

shots.scene: 堆满的柜内气流箭头被挡住，蒸气积聚
shots.prompt_en: Inside a crowded hood, airflow arrows are blocked and a vapor cloud builds up. No people.
shots.narration: 东西太多，挡住气流，蒸气越积越多。

shots.scene: 柜内瓶子旁出现火焰和溢洒图标
shots.prompt_en: Small flame and spill icons beside bottles stored inside a hood, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦溢洒着火，事故会更大。

shots.scene: 小研把试剂瓶放回下方的试剂柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts reagent bottles back into a ventilated storage cabinet below the hood.
shots.narration: 不用的试剂，及时放回原处。

shots.scene: 阿杰离开前把视窗拉下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls the sash all the way down before stepping away from the hood.
shots.narration: 不操作时，把视窗关好。

shots.scene: 柜侧风量监测器亮起红灯
shots.prompt_en: A hood airflow monitor on the side of the hood with a red alarm light on and a bell icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风量监测器报警，说明风不够了。

shots.scene: 监测器上的气流图标变弱，报警灯亮起
shots.prompt_en: On the hood airflow monitor, an airflow icon weakens and the alarm light turns on. No people.
shots.narration: 气流不够控制危害时，它就报警。

shots.scene: 手臂猛地抽出，柜口气流线变乱
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an arm pulled quickly out of the hood, with airflow lines at the opening becoming tangled. No people.
shots.narration: 即使风速100，猛抽手臂也会搅乱。

shots.scene: 有人从柜前快步走过，蒸气被带出
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person walking quickly past the front of a hood, dragging a wisp of vapor out. No people.
shots.narration: 从柜前快步走过，也会把蒸气带出。

shots.scene: 通风柜和吸尘器图标比力气
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood icon next to a vacuum cleaner icon, with the vacuum's suction arrow drawn larger. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜的抽力其实没那么大。

shots.scene: 纸巾被吸向柜后排风缝的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of paper towels being sucked toward the rear exhaust slots, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 纸张别让它吸进排风口。

shots.scene: 卡住的风管和风机图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a duct and fan blocked by crumpled paper, with a downward airflow arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 卡在风管风机里，通风效果大打折扣。

shots.scene: 把头伸进柜内的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person putting their head inside a fume hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不把头伸进通风柜。

shots.scene: 气流被头部挡乱，有害气体靠近口鼻
shots.prompt_en: A diagram showing a head shape disturbing airflow inside a hood, vapor reaching the nose and mouth area. No people.
shots.narration: 既扰乱气流，又可能吸入有害气体。

shots.scene: 阿杰请老周帮忙调整柜内装置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man, his supervisor, for help with an apparatus inside the hood.
shots.narration: 柜内需要调整，找主管。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜图标与化学通风柜图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon next to a chemical fume hood icon, each with a different filter symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒和感染性颗粒，用生物安全柜。

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜内处理标本管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat, gloves and goggles works with sample tubes inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 常用于临床标本、体液等操作。

shots.scene: 过滤器截住细小颗粒和气溶胶，箭头不通向室外
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a filter capturing tiny particles and aerosols while clean air returns into the room, not outdoors. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤系统截住细颗粒，不排到室外。

shots.scene: 高效过滤器剖面，截住极小颗粒
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a pleated high-efficiency filter with tiny particles caught in it. No people.
shots.narration: 高效过滤器截0.3微米颗粒达99.99%。

shots.scene: 气体分子穿过过滤器的图标，旁打警示
shots.prompt_en: Small gas molecule icons passing straight through the filter, with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 但它挡不住有害气体。

shots.scene: 小研指着两个柜子图标问老周
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student asks the older man, her supervisor, which cabinet to use, pointing at two cabinet icons.
shots.narration: 颗粒和气体都有，问主管用哪种柜。

shots.section_title: 还有特殊用途的通风柜
shots.scene: 两台特殊通风柜的图标
shots.prompt_en: Two special hood icons: one with a water spray symbol, one with a radiation trefoil symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 还有专门对付特殊危害的通风柜。
overlay: 还有特殊用途的通风柜

shots.section_title: 还有特殊用途的通风柜
shots.scene: 欣欣指着两台特殊柜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the two special hood icons.
shots.narration: 平时不常用，也要知道它们干什么。

shots.scene: 专用柜内的喷淋冲洗管喷出水雾
shots.prompt_en: Inside a special hood, a washdown spray pipe sprays water down the back walls and duct. No people.
shots.narration: 高氯酸专用柜能用水冲洗柜体和风管。

shots.scene: 冲掉残留的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of residue on duct walls being washed away by water. No people.
shots.narration: 防止危险残留越积越多。

shots.scene: 有机物瓶子放进专用柜的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an organic solvent bottle being placed into the washdown hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这种柜里绝不能用有机物。

shots.scene: 贴有电离辐射标志的专用通风柜
shots.prompt_en: A special fume hood with an ionizing radiation warning sign on it. No people.
shots.narration: 放射性物质，要在专用柜里操作。

shots.scene: 柜体内壁阻隔放射性的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of smooth sealed inner walls of the special hood keeping radiation symbols contained. No people.
shots.narration: 柜体不渗透，减少照射和沾染。

shots.scene: 欣欣看着应急箱、灭火器和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at icons of a spill kit, a fire extinguisher and a telephone.
shots.narration: 再小心也可能出意外，要提前准备。

shots.scene: 柜内台面上的一小摊液体被吸附垫覆盖
shots.prompt_en: An absorbent pad covering a small spill on the work surface inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内溢洒，马上处理。

shots.scene: 小研戴好防护，把用过的吸附垫装进废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves places used absorbent pads into a waste bag.
shots.narration: 按本单位程序吸附、收集、处置。

shots.scene: 安全数据单图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet icon with a light bulb above it. No people.
shots.narration: 事先读过安全数据单，应急才心里有数。

shots.scene: 墙边灭火器和灭火毯，标出位置
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher and a fire blanket mounted on the wall near the hood, with a location pin icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一定要知道最近的灭火器在哪。

shots.scene: 柜内小火苗旁：灭火器图标，以及倒扣的烧杯和表面皿图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside a fume hood, a tiny flame icon next to icons of a fire extinguisher, an inverted beaker and a watch glass. No people.
shots.narration: 小火可用灭火器，或用表面皿、倒扣烧杯盖灭。

shots.scene: 有些通风柜自带灭火装置的开关图标
shots.prompt_en: A hood with a built-in fire suppression switch icon on its side panel. No people.
shots.narration: 有的柜自带灭火装置，按开关启动。

shots.section_title: 火势失控：关窗撤离、报消防
shots.scene: 视窗拉到底，箭头指向出口
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sash pulled fully down, then an arrow pointing to an exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 火控制不住：拉下视窗，马上离开。
overlay: 火势失控：关窗撤离、报消防

shots.section_title: 火势失控：关窗撤离、报消防
shots.scene: 一只手按下走廊墙上的火灾报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: A hand presses a red fire alarm call point on the corridor wall. No faces.
shots.narration: 拉响警报。

shots.section_title: 火势失控：关窗撤离、报消防
shots.scene: 电话图标旁一辆消防车图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon next to a fire truck icon. No people.
shots.narration: 通知消防队。

shots.scene: 风机停转、风量表指针归零
shots.prompt_en: A stopped exhaust fan icon and an airflow gauge with its needle dropping to zero. No people.
shots.narration: 风机或线路故障，通风会突然停下。

shots.scene: 蒸气从停转的柜里溢出
shots.prompt_en: Vapor slowly leaking out of a hood whose fan has stopped. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里的有害物就会跑出来。

shots.scene: 老周和学生们在通风柜前看空白的应急预案
shots.prompt_en: The older man, a supervisor, reviews a blank emergency plan with students in front of a fume hood.
shots.narration: 向主管问清本单位的应急预案。

shots.scene: 停转的风机和设备故障图标旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A stopped fan icon and a broken equipment icon with a question mark beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 设备故障、通风出问题，知道怎么做。

shots.section_title: 在柜里，就是在和危险打交道
shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地站在通风柜前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a fume hood with a serious face.
shots.narration: 需要进柜操作，说明东西有危险。
overlay: 在柜里，就是在和危险打交道

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现合格标签、柜内深处、空柜三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: an inspection tag with a check, a beaker deep inside a hood, and an empty tidy hood.
shots.narration: 检测合格，深处操作，不当储存柜。

shots.scene: 风量表、拉低的视窗、日历和应急包图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an airflow gauge, a lowered sash, a calendar and an emergency kit. No people.
shots.narration: 看监测器，拉低视窗，定期检测。

shots.scene: 化学通风柜和生物安全柜图标，选对打勾
shots.prompt_en: A chemical fume hood icon and a biological safety cabinet icon, with a green check on the matching one. No people.
shots.narration: 选对柜子，用对方法。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现检测标签、风量表和拉低的视窗图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an inspection tag, an airflow gauge and a lowered sash.
shots.narration: 检测合格，视窗拉低，留意监测器。

shots.scene: 烧杯放在柜内深处，柜内台面整洁
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a beaker deep inside a hood and a tidy empty hood surface. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内六英寸操作，不堆东西，动作轻缓。

shots.scene: 化学通风柜、生物安全柜和带辐射标志的专用柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a chemical fume hood, a biological safety cabinet and a special hood with a radiation symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 按危害选对柜子。

shots.scene: 吸附垫、灭火器和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an absorbent pad, a fire extinguisher and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒快处理，火大关窗撤离报警。

shots.scene: 欣欣拉下整洁通风柜的视窗，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot lowers the sash of a tidy fume hood and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 用好通风柜，安心做实验，下次见！
